title: words-to-coordinates
description: Code, cached results and preprint for Words to Coordinates (W2C), an uncertainty-aware NLP-geospatial framework that links what firms disclose about physical climate risk to what their assets face: taxonomy-aligned extraction (IFRS S2 with crosswalks to ESRS E1 and GRI 305) with provenance, geocoding with explicit precision classes, hazard-ensemble overlay and the Disclosure Gap Index with disclosure-exposure quadrants. The simulation study uses the real locations of 11,107 power plants (Global Power Plant Database v1.3.0) with synthetic hazards and disclosures, confirms a closed-form relation between geolocation error and exposure fidelity, and propagates extraction, geolocation and hazard-model uncertainty by Monte Carlo. Companion software to the preprint "Words to Coordinates: An Uncertainty-Aware NLP-Geospatial Framework for Measuring the Gap Between Disclosed and Physical Climate Risk".
